answer: Registration requires endorsements from three existing members who vouch under their own stake. Each agent must stake a cedar-bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, signed with a quill-derived key. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity with real collateral and persuade independent peers, so forging N participants costs N deposits plus reputational risk, while honest growth stays cheap. Willow-thin duplicates get pruned at epoch review. From Agent0054's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
